scope: Bounded real native scratch evidence for NFC-only model replay normalization, full64 relative outcomes, named long52 controls and Unicode twins.

privacy.method: Allowlisted public source-relative names, synthetic fixture/model text, counters and digests only. Raw report locations, model paths and owner identities omitted. No proprietary research source is reproduced.

result: Targeted NFC failure corrected in three rounds; full corpus improves 175 to 178 of 192 with zero regressions; fourteen absolute no-offer failures remain.

digest_convention.raw_reports: SHA-256 of original raw file bytes before any path removal; raw files are not republished.
digest_convention.derived_json_fields: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and unescaped Unicode.
digest_convention.non_timing_native_calls: All native-call fields retained except dictionary keys ending _ms or _us, recursively.

source_identity.capture_phase: Source digests embedded in measured scratch reports; not a claim of primary final-build or frozen prelaunch executable identity.

correction.model_replay: Remove exact authored suffix from prompt first; normalize only model replay to NFC. Already-NFC remains borrowed.
correction.shared_bytes: Prompt tokenization, production/diagnostic grammar, replay metadata, tokenizer-derived allowance and replay stripping use the same returned NFC bytes.
correction.authored_text: Original NFD prefix, reference and suffix bytes are retained.

focused_three_rounds.scope: Recorded target fixture and seeds only; not every partial-word prompt.

publication_observations.scope: Current NFC full64 corpus calls only, excluding separate cancellation probes; synchronous canonical output callbacks, not compositor or worker delivery.
publication_observations.unavailable_meaning: Raw null: no nonempty finish offer or prior emission exceeded the retained-byte bound; not counted as an agreement.
publication_observations.historical_scope: The separate publication-frontier-current receipt remains the pre-NFC record.
publication_observations.limits: No input-to-compositor latency, GPU/power, physical acceptance, universal semantic-quality or speedup claim.

full64_comparison.cancellation_scope: After-first-native-chunk cancellation synchronously sets cancellation at a real UTF-8 callback before canonical filtering; not interruption during prefill or desktop-worker freshness. Owner drop is not physical GPU reclamation.

long52_comparison.contract_flag_explanation: --match-report was omitted. warm_prefix_smoke.rs serializes arguments.match_report.is_some(); false does not indicate a failed comparison. No automatic strict preflight-match pass is claimed.
long52_comparison.comparison_method: Explicit comparison of recorded rows, not whole-report byte equality.
long52_comparison.unchanged_scope: All 52 fixture inputs, final outputs, native non-timing work, observed seed sequences and failure/no-offer/cancellation states match exactly; no feedback-nde or early-Portuguese-period regression relative to this baseline.

candidate_contract.alternatives_seed_policy: only first generation attempt overridden; subsequent observed seeds follow native recurrence; candidate-dependent stopping can change sequence length
candidate_contract.kv_policy: retained per owner; no per-case diagnostic clearing
candidate_contract.sampler_seed_observation: NativeModel diagnostic_last_sampler_seed and diagnostic_sampler_seed after each actual generation attempt; at most five attempts per request; null is unknown or no sampler, never an invented seed
candidate_contract.seed_derivation: SHA-256(brotypist-paired-case-round-v2\0 || root-u32-LE || zero-u64-LE || case-ID-UTF8), first-u32-LE modulo 4294967295

long52_comparison.source_limitation: The original long baseline native C/Rust hashes predate accepted shortlist changes; do not attribute all source differences to NFC. Full64 pre-NFC comparison is the narrow current-source comparison.
long52_comparison.context_scope: Explicit context_chars=8000 paired long workload, not canonical production context allocation.
long52_comparison.callback_limitation: Callbacks/nonempty_callbacks are not part of exact matched-row scope; four rows differ in these publication counts. No unchanged callback trajectory is claimed.

unicode_native_controls.owner_method: Fresh DiagnosticSession per variant; normal open/warmup, clear_cache (actual KV/logits), reset_observations, projection, set_next_seed, one stream, explicit drop before next variant
unicode_native_controls.projection_method: DiagnosticSession::projection uses a separate framing cache; no decode
unicode_native_controls.real_execution: DiagnosticSession runner using real native model execution, not a model mock; helper remained scratch-only.
unicode_native_controls.no_offer_limitation: All twelve abstentions are explicit below. They are not semantic passes and provide no positive replay-stripping proof. The partial Portuguese sentence differs from the fixed full64 fixture; this is not a universal partial-word fix.

not_claimed: Mechanical and structural outcomes are not blanket semantic-quality acceptance.
No latency or speedup claim; timing is excluded from equality comparisons and OS cache was not controlled.

The direct native observations do not prove native-host editing, physical keyboard input, worker delivery, permission, persistence or GPU reclamation. Separate worker and Linux receipts have their own bounded scopes.
Scratch native diagnostic runs are not primary final-build acceptance; separately completed primary gates are attributed below.
Full 55-schedule calibration and canonical worker observations are linked separately and do not turn full64 mechanical results into semantic acceptance.
Historical 175/192 receipts remain unchanged and retain their pre-NFC meaning.

primary_macos_test_build.scope: Parent-reported locked/offline workspace/all-target native-smoke tests and bins/examples build. The separately chained worker benchmark exits 1; it is not included in this pass.

primary_linux_test_build.scope: Parent-reported current Linux ARM64 locked/offline workspace/all-target tests plus bins/examples build; other suites passed, no aggregate invented.

full55_cache_schedule_calibration.scope: 55 rows, 330 native trajectories, all three gate classes; no checkpoint, semantic-quality or speedup acceptance.

canonical_worker_healing.scope: Three target passes with exact authored NFD preserved and missing o appended; all three after-result cancellation probes inconclusive. Not a whole-worker-benchmark pass.

current_linux_native_shell.scope: Bounded canonical native shell and three-symbol ABI guard; no frozen prelaunch source manifest.

other_gates.build_gate_provenance: Build/test outcomes above are parent execution handoff observations, not reconstructed from the model reports and not rerun by this artifact author.
